sources.title: GPT4Scene
sources.snippet: To address this, we introduce GPT4Scene, a novel visual prompting paradigm in VLM training and inference that helps build the global-local relationship, significantly improving the 3D spatial understanding of indoor scenes.

sources.title: GitHub - MIT-SPARK/llm_scene_understanding
sources.snippet: This repo contains code for the paper Leveraging Language Models for Robot 3D Scene Understanding. We present several methods for leveraging language models for 3D scene understanding on scene graphs, like those produced by the Hydra spatial perception system. We test our algorithms on scene graphs generated from the Matterport3D semantic mesh dataset.
